all_non_empty_rows: HOW TO USE THIS WORKBOOK EVERY DAY
1. Open Daily Planner. Today's rows are already there (planned block by block) — no need to add anything.
2. Glance at Dashboard for yesterday's Daily Score and today's Overload status.
3. As you complete (or skip) each block, fill in the yellow cells on Daily Planner: Actual Activity, Actual Duration, Completion Status (dropdown), Energy Level (dropdown), Notes.
4. If a task changes shape entirely (e.g. an interview gets scheduled over a Placement Flex Block), just overwrite Actual Activity and Category for that row — everything downstream recalculates.
Once a week — Saturday 20:00-21:00 Weekly Planning Session
5. Open Weekly Review. Fill sections 1-3 (review last week, log next week's known events/deadlines, set top 5 priorities).
6. Copy next week's block of rows in Daily Planner downward (select this week's 154 rows, copy, paste below, update the Date column) and adjust any Actual columns back to blank/yellow.

7. If Dashboard's Overload Indicator shows Heavy/Red for an upcoming day, use section 5 of Weekly Review to decide what moves to a Flex Block, following the cut order: P3 first, then P2, only then trim (never cancel) a P1 block. Never touch sleep or fixed classes.
8. CFA Tracker: log a row whenever you finish a topic, question set, or mock — CFA Hours (auto) already pulls from Daily Planner, this tracker is for topic-level detail and accuracy.
9. Placement Tracker: add a row per company/opportunity as soon as it appears; update Status as you move through the pipeline.
10. Academic Tracker: add assignment/test rows under the relevant course as they're announced.
11. Fitness Tracker: log each gym session (Completed? = Yes/No/Partial) — this feeds the Gym Sessions KPI.
12. Personal Brand: log content from Idea through Published; do the Weekly Content Review block at the bottom every Friday.
13. Change wake/sleep targets, gym frequency, CFA/Placement hour targets, category weights, or overload thresholds — all in Settings. Everything else recalculates automatically.
14. Yellow-filled cells across every sheet are for you to type in. White/un-filled cells with formulas should be left alone — copy them down when adding new weeks/rows instead of retyping.
15. A blank Dashboard chart usually means this week's Daily Planner rows haven't been filled in yet for Completion Status — the score formulas need at least one non-blank status to divide by.

16. Class timings, DE 343, and the Tuesday 11:30-6:00 span are fixed inputs from your actual timetable — edit them directly on Master Timetable and Daily Planner if your schedule changes; nothing else derives them automatically.

• IDEAL DAY = exactly this grid. Everything lands, all deep-work blocks completed, gym done, sleep protected.
• NORMAL DAY (most common) = this grid, but Placement/Academic/Personal-Brand flex blocks may shrink 15-30 min if energy is average — CFA and Placement blocks are protected first.
• HEAVY DAY (test/interview/deadline) = swap the relevant Placement or Academic flex block for the urgent item; drop Personal Brand and shorten Free blocks to 15 min. Sleep and classes never move.

• RECOVERY / LOW-ENERGY DAY = keep wake/sleep, classes, meals, and one CFA block (concept OR practice, not both). Drop gym for stretching, drop Placement flex, drop Personal Brand. Protect the reduced core so nothing collapses.
• FLEX BLOCKS (Free / Personal Brand / non-protected Academic slots) absorb missed CFA, Placement, gym, or academic tasks first — see 'Smart Rescheduling' in the Weekly Review sheet.

• IF OVERLOADED, CUT IN THIS ORDER: P3 (extra reading/content) -> P2 (gym/personal brand, reschedule don't skip) -> optional P1 (trim CFA/Placement block, never cancel outright). Never cut sleep or fixed classes.
